newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P puts STB Cayman yen bond on CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts STB Cayman yen bond on CreditWatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Monday it had assigned its BBB+ rating to STB Cayman Capital Ltd's planned 100 billion yen issue of mandatory exchangeable subordinated guaranteed notes due 2007, and at the same time placed the notes on CreditWatch with negative implications.
S&P said in a statement that the rating was in line with parent firm Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd's A- senior debt rating which had also been placed on CreditWatch.
S&P said Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd's rating reflects its strong market position, mediocre profitability, continuing asset quality problems and adequate capital position.

S&P said its placement of Sumitomo Trust's A- long-term rating on CreditWatch with negative implications reflects the potentially negative effects on Sumitomo Trust's operating performance of deregulation and the changing competitive environment in Japan's financial markets.
The CreditWatch action is expected to be resolved within the next month, after discussions with Sumitomo Trust's management, S&P said.
